properties.name: Five served skills' frontmatter is not strict YAML: a `: ` inside a plain-scalar description (check-health, link-ideas, onboarding, plan-increments, where-am-i)
properties.statement: Measured 2026-10-05 while building the VS Code skill stubs: PyYAML's safe_load refuses the frontmatter of getting-started/skills/{check-health,link-ideas,onboarding,plan-increments,where-am-i}/SKILL.md with "mapping values are not allowed here", because each description is a plain scalar containing `: `. Claude Code and reflow2's own build.rs parse it leniently. A harness with a strict YAML parser would drop those skills, and VS Code says a skill it cannot read "silently fail[s] to load". The VS Code stubs quote their descriptions, so they are not affected; the skills themselves, and their .claude and .grok mirrors that VS Code also reads, are unchanged. The fix belongs in skill_lint (a strict-YAML frontmatter check) and in the five descriptions.
